comment: do.c goto_level() leaving the tutorial calls nhlua.c tutorial(FALSE), whose nhlib.lua tutorial_leave() callback runs nh.gamestate(true): nhl_gamestate() resets the turn counter to the stored move, prints "Resetting time to move #1.", and gives back the sequestered inventory, hero struct, discoveries, monster statistics and spellbook. The wizard-mode level teleport menu picks Dungeons of Doom level 2, which is built at the reset turn, and i shows the restored inventory.
